body: Quick pass (M5): the body is complete (what changed, pins with mutation results, gates, not exercised: the GUI hand check, `Refs #692`), the quick gate, the full ui lib and clippy are green at c255003d, #692 is P3 (not paused), and there are no snapshot PNGs. Flagged ready; a review by the other session is next. The maintainer's GUI hand check on #692 stays owed.

Review fixes pushed as 86407ed2 (`test(pick): pin the centre paths of points_pick::take, picks_text and pick_coords`). The change is test-only. The PR was already a draft, and it still merges cleanly with upstream/main.

**New pins**
- `crates/ui/src/centre_pick_tests.rs` (new ui lib module, holed-plate fixture):
  - `three_points_draft_a_round_edge_as_its_centre_and_refuse_a_straight_one`: a straight edge is refused ("is an edge with no centre ... straight") and nothing is drafted. A round rim is drafted as point 1. After two corners, a 4th point (the bottom rim) is refused with "Remove last or Clear", and the draft is unchanged.
  - `an_axis_by_two_points_drafts_a_round_edge_and_reads_out_its_centre`: an axis by points refuses a straight edge and drafts the rim. `picks_text` reads exactly `1 of 2 points on 'plate' (5.000, -3.000, 10.000) mm`.
- `crates/app/tests/centre_pick.rs`:
  - `pick_coords_reports_a_round_edge_as_its_centre`: the rim gives one point, the centre. A straight side gives its two ends.
  - `a_straight_edge_is_named_before_the_pick_count`: `[corner, straight side]` is refused with the straight-edge reason, not "pick three points - 2 picked".

**`datum_of`'s `centre_point` line: pinned, not dropped.** The line can be reached. With fewer than three picks, `point()` is never called: the count check returns first. Without this line, a straight edge among 1-2 picks would get the generic count message instead of being named. The same applies before a later face pick. The last test above pins this.

**Mutation check** (each guard broken, suite re-run, then restored):
| Guard broken | Result |
|---|---|
| `points_pick::take` straight-edge arm -> `if false && ...` | red: `three_points_draft_...` |
| `points_pick::take` refuse every edge (`if true`), so no centre is accepted | red: `three_points_draft_...` |
| `points_pick::take` 4th-point guard narrowed to `Vertex` only | red: `three_points_draft_...` |
| `axis_pick::take` straight-edge arm -> `if false` | red: `an_axis_by_two_points_...` |
| `axis_pick::picks_text` `centre` -> `false` | red: `an_axis_by_two_points_...` |
| `pick_coords` `.or_else(centre_of)` fallback removed | red: `pick_coords_reports_...` (app) and `an_axis_by_two_points_...` (ui) |
| `datum_of` `centre_point(world, g)?` removed | red: `a_straight_edge_is_named_before_the_pick_count` |

After every mutation was restored, all of them are green again.

**Gate** (head 86407ed2):
- app `centre_pick` (8), plus `align_axes`, `axis_align`, `points_align`, `mcp_align_axes`, `mcp_pick`, `pick`, `feature_pick`, `vertex_pick`, `circular_pick`, `fixture_locate`, `pick_agnostic`: all ok
- ui lib (single-threaded, from `crates/ui`): 665 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Ready for a re-review.
